_me_formula_note: ME_SCORE (the TRUTH-formula analogue for the Master Equation domain) = slot_coverage_bonus + slot_hits_total x slot weight (1.0) + product_test hits x 1.5 + grounding hits x 2.0 + contradiction hits x -0.5 + jargon hits x -0.3 + propaganda hits x -2.0. slot_coverage_bonus = (slots_covered / 10) x coverage_bonus_weight (10.0): a paper that speaks to all ten slots earns the full bonus. Fit-language, canon-status and drift-marker hits are reported but carry weight 0.0 (descriptive, not scored).
